todos.text: Make each level of certification last one cycle — may need intermediary levels between the 3 collars
todos.notes:
PROPOSAL (maps to ATA 3 collars: Trainer red/black → Specialty Trainer black/red/black → Certified Instructor black):

Assume LVLUP cycle ≈ 2 months. Goal: one cert step per cycle (clear, predictable).

Current gap: 3 collars often span many cycles with uneven load. Add intermediary "lane" ranks between collars so each cycle has a named checkpoint.

Suggested ladder (6 steps = ~1 year to black collar if continuous):
1. Assistant Trainee (no collar) — cycle 1: assist 100% of classes on roster, YPP, desk basics
2. Trainer Candidate (pin/stripe on dobok, not collar) — cycle 2: teach life skills + 1 form block under CI
3. Trainer (red/black collar) — cycle 3: Level 1 coursework complete + 100 assist hrs
4. Specialty Candidate (stripe on red/black) — cycle 4: Level 2 + specialty track (Tiny Tigers / leadership / sparring)
5. Specialty Trainer (black/red/black) — cycle 5: Level 2 signed + specialty demo
6. Certified Instructor (black) — cycle 6+: Level 3 + ATA CI packet / age / background

Intermediaries 2 & 4 are in-house LVLUP markers (not ATA collars) so we don't invent fake ATA ranks.

NEED FROM YOU:
1) Is cycle length 8 weeks for staff cert too?
2) OK with in-house Candidate markers between the 3 ATA collars?
3) Who owns the checklist (you, Richelle, or a CI per school)?
